title: English Practice Quiz 0996
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: A place where medicines are dispensed is a ___.
questions.explanation: A pharmacy is a place where medicines are prepared or supplied.

questions.question: Someone says, 'Thank you for your help.' You reply:
questions.explanation: You're welcome is a natural response to thank you.

questions.question: Which question asks for a reason?
She said, 'I can swim.'
options: She said that she could swim.
questions.explanation: Can commonly changes to could in reported speech after a past reporting verb.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.
questions.explanation: After doesn't, use the base form of the verb: like.
